title: House Democrats File Resolution Against Federal Bailouts for AI Companies
summary:
A measure introduced in the U.S. House of Representatives would prevent the government from using public funds to rescue artificial intelligence firms facing insolvency during a financial crisis. The resolution stipulates that any failing AI companies must undergo the standard bankruptcy process rather than receiving a federal bailout.

House Democrats described the filing as a pre-emptive effort to ensure the sector is not granted special status or emergency funding if the industry collapses. The proposal was introduced on Oct. 28, though no timeline for a vote has been established.
